title: Normalized derived adjunction and tensor for lattice actions
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [def-weil-size-convention], and use internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] and internal actions [def-sfb-condensed-action-module]. For $r\geq0$, use the ordinary discrete lattice action category $\mathcal E=\operatorname{Action}(\operatorname{Mod}_R,\mathbf Z^r)$, its actual invariant limit $\Gamma$ and its total right derived functor $R\Gamma$ from [lem-sfb-discrete-lattice-koszul-resolution], in the ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with the canonical derived invariants calculus of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus]. The action category is Grothendieck abelian, its diagonal tensor is closed, and it has functorial flat resolutions. Define the trivial-action functor $t$ by the identity action, and take its adjunction with $\Gamma$ normalized so that inverse transpose is composition with the invariant inclusion. Use the unique comparison from the recorded total derived functor to the universal right-derived functor preserving the computation unit. Derive this adjunction with exact left adjoint $t$. Equip $D(t)$ with the unique strong tensor structure whose comparison on flat K-flat cochain representatives is localization of the ordinary identity tensor comparison, and whose unit is the localization of the ordinary tensor unit. Give $R\Gamma$ the resulting right-adjoint lax tensor structure: its binary map is the mate of the tensor of the two counits. This specifies the canonical adjunction, strong derived trivial-action tensor, and adjoint lax derived-invariants tensor, without any flatness, characteristic, or nonzero hypothesis on $R$.
